other.query: SELECT REPLACE(c.icd10, ' ', '') as a_code, REPLACE(c.t_name, ',', '') as t_name, concat(c.cgroup, ' ', t_name) a_name, c.e_name, SUM( CASE WHEN sex = '1' THEN result ELSE '0' END ) AS male, SUM( CASE WHEN sex = '2' THEN result ELSE '0' END ) AS female, SUM( CASE WHEN sex not in ('1', '2') THEN result ELSE '0' END ) AS sex_error, SUM( CASE WHEN sex in ('1', '2') THEN result ELSE '0' END ) AS total FROM cgroup298disease as c INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s inner join chospital_regis as h on h.hoscode = s.hospcode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id = {{REPORT_ID}} AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and ( h.zone_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.chw_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.amp_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.tmb_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.dep = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.mcode IN ('ALL') OR 'ALL' IN ('ALL') ) AND ( h.mcode IN ('ALL') OR 'ALL' IN ('ALL') ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ('ALL') OR 'ALL' IN ('ALL') ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) ) as s ON c.cgroup_id = CAST(s.groupcode298 AS varchar) WHERE LEFT(REPLACE(c.icd10, ' ', ''), 1) <> 'Z' GROUP BY c.icd10, c.t_name, c.cgroup, c.e_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 15

rows.query_areacode:
SELECT 
		REPLACE(c.icd10, ' ', '') as a_code,
		REPLACE(c.t_name, ',', '') as t_name,
		concat(c.cgroup, ' ',t_name) a_name,
		c.e_name,
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex='1' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS male,
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex='2' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS female,
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex not in(1,2) THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS sex_error,		
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex in(1,2) THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS total
FROM	cgroup298disease as c	 INNER JOIN 
	( 
	SELECT *  FROM	{tablename} as s {jointable} {joinwith} 
	WHERE  s.id='{reportid}' AND s.b_year = '{year}' 
	) as s ON c.cgroup_id =s.groupcode298  
	
WHERE 1=1 {where}
GROUP BY	1 
HAVING LEFT(a_code,1) <> 'Z'
ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 15
